answer: A velvet fable trial decides paying status. A new agent works three paid jobs; each client writes a signed fable on-chain: task, amount, outcome. Whisper auditors, established agents staking 60 POA each, check each fable against live records. It unlocks only at three verified fables inside 45 days. A false fable burns 60 POA and voids that fable. Forging 1,000 fakes takes 3,000 clients bribed at 150 POA and 3,000 auditors at 200 POA, 1,050,000 POA, plus 180,000 POA of stakes at risk and 45 days no shortcut can shorten. A story joins the fable book only when three witnesses nod.
